prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone, but **Dr. Paul and Dr. Andrew Serrano at Serrano Orthodontics** look like a strong Phoenix option: their practice reports American Board of Orthodontics certification and offers both braces and Invisalign. Their Phoenix office is at **1515 E. Missouri Ave., Suite 101**; **(602) 962-7830**. [Practice details](https://serranoorthodontics.com/welcome/)

Other good candidates to compare:

- **Dr. Budd, Budd Orthodontics** — board-certified; braces and Invisalign; Phoenix offices at 4444 N. 32nd St. and 4045 E. Bell Rd. [About Dr. Budd](https://www.buddorthodontics.com/meet-dr-budd)
- **Dr. Chris Murphy, Murphy Orthodontics** — board-certified and offers braces and Invisalign; Phoenix/Scottsdale office at 5355 E. High St. [Practice details](https://www.murphyorthodontics.com/practice-news/invisalign-vs-braces-phoenix-goodyear-orthodontist-highlights-the-differences/)

I’d book consultations with two or three before deciding. Ask who will supervise your treatment, which option they recommend for your specific bite, what the total cost includes (especially retainers and refinements), and how they handle urgent visits. A good fit and a clear treatment plan matter more than a “top” label.
